import sys

def compress_sentence(words):
    compressed = words[0]
    for word in words[1:]:
        # Find the longest prefix of the current word that matches a suffix of the compressed word
        max_match_length = 0
        for i in range(1, min(len(compressed), len(word)) + 1):
            if compressed[-i:] == word[:i]:
                max_match_length = i
        # Append the non-matching part of the current word to the compressed word
        compressed += word[max_match_length:]
    return compressed

    n = int(data[0])
    words = data[1:]

    print(compressed_word)
